name: @pipeworx/mcp-dchub

tools.name: dchub_execute_plan
tools.description: Answer a multi-part data-center question in one call (DC Hub): e.g. "rank markets for a 200 MW AI campus" or "power headroom in PJM". Plans and runs the needed lookups and returns the combined result with citations. Keyless calls return a preview.

intent.description: The question, unchanged, e.g. "rank markets for a 200 MW AI campus"

tools.name: dchub_search_facilities
tools.description: Find data centers and who operates them (DC Hub facility registry), filtered by city, state, country, operator or MW range. Returns name, operator, location and verification flag; MW detail needs a DC Hub key. Keyless calls return a preview.

tools.name: dchub_get_market_intel
tools.description: Data-center market intelligence for one metro (DC Hub): facility count, tracked MW, status mix, top providers, pipeline and lease pricing. Market is a slug such as northern-virginia. Keyless calls return a trimmed preview.

market.description: Market slug, e.g. northern-virginia, dallas, phoenix

tools.name: dchub_get_grid_data
tools.description: Live electricity grid data for one grid (DC Hub): fuel mix and demand for US ISOs (PJM, ERCOT, CAISO, MISO, SPP, NYISO, ISO-NE), utility balancing authorities, and international grids.

iso.description: Grid code, e.g. PJM, ERCOT, CAISO

tools.name: dchub_source_capacity
tools.description: Search data-center capacity available to buy or lease (DC Hub Capacity Source): powered land, powered shells, turnkey capacity and colocation, by size (min_kw / min_mw) and location (region, state, market).

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-dchub forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the dchub pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
